request:
镜头 s32：纪录片空镜，时长 8 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
风格模式：固定风格（style preset sp01-v75）。锁定外观 / Locked look（detailed_description 第一行必须照此书写，并逐字包含 ['Sony FX6', 'S-Cinetone']）：Locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera handheld; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark.
该类型的纪录片默认机位：documentary establishing shot on a long zoom lens, atmospheric haze
导演意图（自然语言）：高机位俯拍，固定。地下城竖井里的灯，一个区接一个区地灭下去，最后几乎全黑。环境声：空旷的风声、遥远的呼喊。
情绪：ominous, desolate, hushed
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：wide high-angle shot looking down the shaft, locked-off
景深与虚实：Deep focus on the near walls, the depths dissolving into darkness.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: One single image, no people in the foreground: high angle looking down the huge vertical shaft of the underground city, stacked cabins on the walls, most of their windows already dark, only a few clusters of lit windows left in the blackness. Blocking lock: the vertical shaft runs down the centre of frame, lit cabin windows on both walls fading toward the dark bottom; no characters visible.
Picture 2: the underground city main street (location reference; role: location reference). Wide shot of the main street of a huge underground city five kilometres below the surface: stacked steel habitation modules on both sides, exposed pipes and cable trays overhead, steam vents, food stalls with warm bulbs, crowds of ordinary people in padded work clothes, puddles on the concrete floor, haze in the air.
本镜头没有台词。
现场环境声：hollow wind in the shaft, distant faint shouting
参考词汇（检索所得，只借用术语与思路，不要整段照抄，不得改变锁定外观）：
[rules/angle/high-angle] angle
[ours/sound-crisis] 声音：危机现场
[rules/lens/documentary-zoom] lens
[ours/tex-underground] 地下城工业纪实质感
[ours/cam-interview] 机位：采访固定机位
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。

attempts.output:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the high-angle storyboard keyframe of the underground city shaft from <Picture 1>, serving as composition, lighting and blocking reference. A vast vertical shaft looks down past stacked cabins clamped to both walls; most cabin windows are already dark, with only a few clusters of lit windows left in the blackness. The air is hazy, the bottom disappears into black, and there are no people in the foreground. Palette: cold steel grey, dirty amber window light, alarm red; available light only, hard contrast, deep blacks. Blocking lock: the vertical shaft runs down the centre of frame; lit cabin windows on both the left and right walls fade toward the dark bottom; no characters visible in the foreground, middle ground or background.
<Subject 2> is the underground city main street from <Picture 2>, serving as the city's location and material reference. A wide street of a huge underground city five kilometres below the surface: stacked steel habitation modules on both sides, exposed pipes and cable trays overhead, steam vents, food stalls with warm bulbs, crowds of ordinary people in padded work clothes, puddles on the concrete floor, haze in the air. Palette: worn steel grey, dirty concrete, warm stall bulbs, faint industrial green; light comes from practical bulbs, vents and distant fixtures, with deep shadow between them. No text, numbers or signs.
summary:
In the underground city in 2075, an 8-second documentary establishing shot looks down the vast vertical shaft in the locked "2075 crisis verite" look. District by district the cabin lights cut out, leaving the shaft almost entirely black. There is no dialogue; the clip ends on the wide dark shaft, only a red beacon and a faint monitor glow far down the wall still holding shape, and the last frame holds.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in this shot): fully_preserved — composition, environment, lighting and layout retained as the opening frame.
<Subject 2> (appears in this shot as the city's material and lighting reference): fully_preserved — environment, lighting and layout retained.
detailed_description:
16:9 horizontal, single clip 8.0s, 24fps, locked look "2075 crisis verite" (style preset sp01-v75): a Sony FX6 full-frame documentary camera body, handheld rig locked off on a high-angle mount for this shot; S-Cinetone at high ISO; a 24mm prime at f/4; filter UV only; grade: deep solid blacks, true-to-life skin, colour only from the practical sources; light: available light only: alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights; volumetric haze and silhouettes; texture: visible high-ISO noise, focus occasionally hunting; raw verite in a city that has lost its light; faces and key objects readable, the rest dark; real documentary footage, not a movie, not CGI, unposed; no hard subtitles, no burned-in captions, no on-screen text, no logo, watermark or platform bugs.
[Shot 1] At 0.0s, wide high-angle shot looking down the vertical shaft from a fixed mount at the upper lip, locked-off with no camera movement, start and end framing identical. pacing: natural speed, a single continuous take with no cut. Blocking at start: frame left and frame right, the stacked cabin walls rise and fall away; frame centre, the open shaft drops into blackness; foreground, the worn steel lip and a low safety rail; background, the far shaft wall and the unlit bottom; no characters in frame. Start: several clusters of cabin windows burn warm amber high on both walls, their light catching haze and condensation on the steel. Middle: a relay clunks somewhere at frame left, and the lights die in sequence, district by district — upper-left windows first, then the right wall lower down, then a whole band across the middle, each cluster snapping from amber to black; a single red alarm beacon pulses at a mid-level landing, then steadies. End: only two or three small windows still glow near the upper right, then they too cut out, leaving the shaft almost completely black, the bottom invisible, only the red beacon and a faint blue-green monitor glow far down the wall holding shape. Mood: ominous, desolate, hushed. Blur: the near cabin walls, rail and rivets stay sharp in deep focus; the middle and lower shaft dissolve gradually into black, with no shallow bokeh. No character speaks any line in this shot; any human voices are indistinct, unintelligible Mandarin Chinese walla only. Hold the last frame.
overall_soundscape:
Hollow wind moving through the shaft, faint distant shouting, low electrical hum from the cabin walls, a relay clunk, light switches snapping off in sequence, dripping condensation, a brief steam hiss, then a deepening near-silence; raw production location sound only, dry and unscored, no background music.

N/A
